svg.title: Mission control: GitHub contributions and daily project commits
svg.desc: 1362 GitHub contributions in the last year. Public project activity over 30 days. Most active three-hour window in the sampled commits: 23:00–02:00 IST.
svg.text: 391 unique public commit timestamps · up to 100/repo · 7 active repos · 90-day lookback · IST
Public project rows exclude profile maintenance. Calendar follows GitHub's contribution rules.
